company.name: Saphira AI
company.shortDescription: Saphira AI is an artificial intelligence company that offers a software for hardware products to get and maintain safety certification.
company.description: Saphira AI provides a platform for managing compliance in hardware product development. It supports regulatory frameworks such as ISO 26262, ISO 10218, and IEC 61508. The system centralizes requirements, risk assessments, test cases, and verification data, and includes functions for generating safety cases, conducting hazard analyses, and monitoring compliance. It also integrates with engineering tools to maintain traceability across design, code, tests, and models.
